messages:
violet: Heads-up: hit a parity issue across SDK samples where request IDs show up in OTEL spans but get masked (<redacted>) in some logs after an auth retry. Seems tied to when we flip loglevel during retry paths.

omar: Which sample and what steps? Can you paste a tiny log excerpt?

violet: sample-python quickstart. Env: REDACT=1 LOG_LEVEL=info OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:4318. Hit /authenticate; we simulate 401 then 200. Snippet:
```ninfo auth: start uid=pat req=rid-A12
debug http: retrying token refresh attempt=2
info auth: success uid=pat req=<redacted>
```
Span attributes exported show req=rid-A12. Only final INFO got redacted.

lee: My guess: redact middleware runs as part of the formatter and expects structured fields present on the logging event. If span attributes are attached later (OTEL hook does async enrichment), formatter just redacts by default.

omar: Quick mitigation: ensure req_id is added as a structured field on the span/request context as early as possible (before the HTTP client call). That way both the formatter and OTEL exporter can read the same source.

lee: Also consider making the redaction step prefer structured attributes (span or record.field) over regexing the formatted message. Safer with batching/async exporters.

violet: I'll add a small change to sample-python: create span with attribute req_id at handler entry and set req_id on the request context. Will also add a one-line note in the quickstart about ordering.

omar: Can someone check node/go/rust samples for the same pattern and drop tiny patches? We should keep the fix consistent across languages.

ci-bot: Created DX-1294: "sampleapps: make req_id propagation deterministic and prefer structured redaction" (https://redwood.internal/DX-1294)

lee: I'll mirror the fix in go and add a unit test that toggles the simulated retry to assert logs contain the raw req_id when REDACT=off and are consistently structured when REDACT=on.

violet: Thanks. Pasted repro steps and log snippets into DX-1294. If anyone finds a different root cause in their runtime, drop it into the ticket.
